climate: Tempranillo and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
A dry climate, though much of its little rain falls while the vines grow. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: A single-estate Vino de Pago in Requena, Valencia. Wines are made from Tempranillo, Merlot and Syrah for red, and Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc for white.
